name: New Jersey
permitAge: 16 (special learner permit, enrolled in an approved behind-the-wheel driver training course; handbook p. 15, 19); 17 (examination permit, no driver training needed; handbook p. 16, 20); 21+ adult examination permit with 3 months supervised (p. 17)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 in darkness, certified on the Certification of Supervised Driving form (BA-CSD) (handbook p. 15-16)
teen.holdPermit: At least 6 months of supervised driving without suspension before the road test if under 21; 3 months if 21 or older (handbook p. 15-17)
teen.nightLimit: Permit and probationary drivers under 21: no driving 11:01 p.m. to 5:00 a.m.; exemption only for employment or religion with a signed letter (handbook p. 18-19)
teen.passengerLimit: Permit and probationary under 21: dependents plus one other passenger, unless a parent or guardian is in the car (handbook p. 18)
teen.phone: Permit and probationary (GDL) holders: no hand-held or hands-free phone or electronic device. All drivers: hand-held ban; fines $200-$400 first offense, $400-$600 second, $600-$800 third or later with 3 points and possible 90-day suspension (handbook p. 86).

notes: Handbook: New Jersey Driver Manual 2026, listed on the MVC manuals page as 'Revised 09/26' (PDF dated 2026-09-23). Printed page = PDF page - 2. Read 2026-10-09.
MVC also publishes the manual in Spanish, Chinese, Tagalog, Gujarati, Korean, Arabic, Haitian Creole and Portuguese: https://www.nj.gov/mvc/about/manuals.htm

Knowledge test: 50 questions plus an organ-donation survey question; pass 40 of 50 (80 percent) (handbook p. 30-31). Offered in English, ASL and 12 other languages including Spanish, Arabic and Chinese; oral test with headphones; approved interpreter possible after a first attempt (p. 30).
Supervising driver: at least 21, valid New Jersey license, at least 3 years of driving experience, in the front seat (handbook p. 18).

GDL decals: two red reflective decals, top left of the front and rear plates, $4 a pair, for permit and probationary drivers under 21 (handbook p. 19). Breaking GDL restrictions: $100 fine or suspension (p. 14).
Hour, passenger and decal limits do not apply to examination permit or probationary holders 21 or older; the phone ban does (handbook p. 18).
Failed knowledge test: re-test after 7 days; failed road test: 14 days (MVC page https://www.nj.gov/mvc/license/youngadult.htm). Not in the handbook.

School bus (N.J.S.A. 39:4-128.1): stop at least 25 feet away; on a dual-lane highway on the other side of a safety island or raised median, slow to 10 mph; in front of a school, pass at no more than 10 mph (handbook p. 77).
Keep right (N.J.S.A. 39:4-82, 39:4-88): on a multi-lane road use the right lane except to pass or prepare for a left turn (handbook p. 65).

Move Over (N.J.S.A. 39:4-92.2): change lanes or slow below the posted limit; covers emergency, tow, highway maintenance vehicles and stopped or disabled vehicles with hazard lights, flares or triangles; fine $100 to $500 (handbook p. 78).
Safe Passing (N.J.S.A. 39:4-92.4): move over a lane, or leave 4 feet, or slow to 25 mph and be ready to stop; $100 fine, $500 and 2 points if someone is hurt (handbook p. 146, 150).
